sectionHeights.method: headless Chromium against the running clone (dev server), scrollY 0 after fonts.ready; heights = getBoundingClientRect of each top-level child of <main> mapped to its semantic node (pricing plan section split at the billing-tabs top; the homepage scale slider/mobile pair and the stats marquee/stack pair are one node each). Overlays render nothing until triggered (0px). The fixed inner-page navbar overlays the page (fixed: true).

liveParity.pixelParity: NOT MEASURED. No live-site capture was taken in this pass (R12); no pixel-compare number exists and none is claimed.
liveParity.note: Live heights are the Playwright measurements recorded in the project's own specs; clone heights were re-measured in this pass. This is a geometry cross-check, not a pixel parity gate.

Per node, from the rendered DOM (visible elements only): heading = first h1/h2; eyebrow = a short uppercase leaf before the heading; lead = first

(text); bullets = leaf

assetRoleRules: Reference roles were assigned per image from its file name and section (extraction rule in the build): teachable-logo* -> brand.wordmark; soc2/security-* -> certification.mark; app-hub-*, payment-method tiles and integration hub -> partner.logo; enterprise *-logo.svg and the customer logo row -> customer.logo; creator/story/case-study/testimonial/video-review photos and example-school avatars -> person.photo; other .svg -> icon.source; names indicating UI/product composites -> product.screenshot; everything else -> photo.source-scene (the most restrictive photo role). Third-party iframes -> media.third-party-embed.
referenceLinkRedaction: Reference examples keep only the ORIGIN of external links (https://host/), never the path, so real people's names in URL slugs are not stored; links to customer schools (their own domains or school subdomains) become https://customer-site.invalid/ because those domains are kept only as hashes. Asset refs are kept as file paths into the clone's public/assets (verified by verify_all ASSET_REFS); some file names contain creator or brand names: they are evidence pointers, never content, and every such role is rejected in generated mode.

liveEndpointsOmitted.handling: live third-party application form: link.live-endpoint is forbidden in every mode, so the reference example uses '#' for that action

externalEvidence.note: Build-time evidence outside this package (path:line, relative to the clone project root). extraction/verify_all.py re-reads these when the clone project surrounds this folder and degrades to a warning when it does not.

groundworkCorrections.claim: BUILD_NOTES.md says the enterprise customer wordmark was extracted to /assets/enterprise-quote-logo.svg and used by QuoteBanner.
groundworkCorrections.finding: The quote banner now renders /assets/placeholder-quote-logo.svg with alt 'Placeholder company logo' and a fictional quote; enterprise-quote-logo.svg (a real customer wordmark) is present in public/assets but unused.

groundworkCorrections.claim: CLONE_SPEC.md §0.6 'No box-shadows anywhere on the page.'
groundworkCorrections.finding: True for the homepage only; inner pages use six shadow tokens (tile, embed, frame, chip, submit, modal), recorded as elevation.* tokens.

groundworkCorrections.claim: Reduced-motion behaviour is implied for every motion in the specs.
groundworkCorrections.finding: The clone honours prefers-reduced-motion only in DemoUnlockHero; every other reducedMotionFallback in this repo is a prescriptive requirement for generated pages (motion-patterns.json sourceHonoursReducedMotion).

groundworkCorrections.claim: src/App.jsx comment: 'unbuilt slugs fall back to ComingSoon'.
groundworkCorrections.finding: Every one of the 17 slugs has a page component registered in PAGES, so ComingSoon is never rendered; all 18 routes are live.
